_comment: Strategy and scheduling knobs for the options agent. Read by options_agent/config.py.

account._comment: starting_buying_power anchors the Rule 9 reserve check. Null means: snapshot it from the account on first run and persist to data/account_baseline.json.

iv._comment: skip_when_regime_low is false for the hackathon run: plan.md's risk table says start permissive and tighten as P&L builds. Flip to true to only sell premium when it is genuinely expensive.

execution._comment: limit_price_slippage shaves 2c off the mid so the credit order has a realistic chance of filling without giving away the whole edge.

position_management._comment: Take profit once half the credit is captured. Cut at a loss equal to the credit received. Always close by 2 DTE to avoid pin and assignment risk.

market_hours._comment: Informational. The runtime gate uses Alpaca's own clock endpoint, not these values.
